advancement.wintercore.fimbulwinter.desc: Construct and activate the ultimate zero-absolute suppression device
tooltip.wintercore.winter_core.line1: Requires a full multiblock structure to activate
tooltip.wintercore.winter_core.line2: Place on Pedestal, surround with Stones & Pillars
tooltip.wintercore.winter_core_base: Forms the foundation platform of the Fimbulwinter structure
tooltip.wintercore.winter_core_pedestal: Channel pillar energy upward to the Core
tooltip.wintercore.winter_core_pillar: Place two at each of the four cardinal directions
ponder.wintercore.winter_core_assembly.s: Lay 9 Fimbulwinter Stones in a cross pattern — 4 in each cardinal direction from center
Place the Fimbulwinter Pedestal at the very center on top of the base
Erect two Fimbulwinter Pillars at each of the four cardinal positions
Set the Winter Core on top of the Pedestal to complete the structure
ponder.wintercore.winter_core_assembly.a: The Fimbulwinter Core is now active — it will purify infections within its radius
tooltip.wintercore.winter_energy_cell: Packed with high-density plasma. Powers the core.
